purpose: Teach: ボウル/信州/舞踏/南極/ドリブル/遊園/ラスベガス/ポルノ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが大きなボウルでお米を研いでらしたぞ
lines.en: You know, Gran—when I was young, your father used to wash the rice in such a big bowl.
lines.style: Soft, distant gaze into the past. Quiet voice like touching something fragile. Pause before the memory unfolds. Nostalgic without being sad.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、信州の温泉宿をお気に入りだったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Oh yes, dear—your grandfather did love that hot spring inn in Shinshu, didn't he?
lines.style: Warm, slightly musical lilt. Affirming his memory while gently weaving in her own. Patient breath between phrases. The tone of someone who remembers alongside him.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、ばあさんが社交舞踏を習われたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, you studied ballroom dancing, didn't you?
lines.style: Voice carries a small smile. Tender admiration underneath. Speaks slowly, as if watching her move through that memory. Slightly breathless—the awe of recalling something you didn't know was important.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、南極の番組をテレビでご覧になったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Dear—you watched that Antarctic documentary on television, didn't you?
lines.style: Light curiosity in the question. Warm tease underneath. Slight upward lilt at the end, inviting him into the shared knowing. The rhythm of long companionship.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがバスケのドリブル指導されたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, your father taught basketball dribbling, didn't he?
lines.style: Voice softens with admiration. Slow, reverent pace. Small wonder in how he shapes the words—he's not just remembering, he's honoring. Trailing slightly on the final thought.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お孫さんを遊園地に連れて行かれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you took our grandchildren to the amusement park, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Warm, gently teasing affection. The lilt of a wife reminding her husband of his own kindness. Unhurried. A small private laugh underneath—the tenderness of calling out his gentleness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、ラスベガスのお話を新聞で読んだぞ
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, I read about Las Vegas in the newspapers.
lines.style: Quiet, contemplative opening. Pause before Vegas—it's small, almost trivial in the landscape of his memories. Gentle, matter-of-fact delivery. A thread he's following, not judging.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ポルノに関するお話は決してなさらなかったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Dear—you've never been one to talk about such things, have you?
lines.style: Warm, slightly protective affection. Gentle correction wrapped in admiration. Understated dignity. A soft closure—she's not asking, she's affirming his decency. Smallest smile at the end.
